meta.title: Fort: Gym Workout Tracker
meta.description: Fort is a workout log for Android: routines, sets and progress saved on your phone, with no account and no connection needed.
meta.ogImageAlt: Fort logo next to the text “Your gym notebook, without the noise.”
app.name: Fort
nav.label: Main
langPicker.label: Language
hero.title: Your gym notebook, without the noise.
hero.description: Set up your routines once, pick the one for each day and log every set as you go. Everything is saved on your phone, even without a connection.
hero.screenshotAlt: Fort logging the sets of a back squat during a legs workout
highlights.languages: Spanish, Catalan, English, French, Basque and Portuguese
steps.title: Plan. Train. Track your progress.
steps.plan.title: Plan your routine
steps.plan.description: Set up your routines once with the exercises, sets and reps you want. They'll be ready for every session.
steps.plan.imageAlt: A person in a black T-shirt checking their phone at the gym
steps.plan.screenshotAlt: Fort's edit routine screen with a push routine and five exercises
steps.train.title: Start training
steps.train.description: Pick today's routine and log each set as you finish it. That's all you have to do.
steps.train.imageAlt: A rack of dumbbells lined up in a gym
steps.train.screenshotAlt: Fort's workout summary showing the duration, exercises and sets of a finished legs workout
steps.progress.title: Track your progress
steps.progress.description: Check the weights and reps of every exercise over time, and edit any past set if you need to.
steps.progress.imageAlt: Close-up of a weight stack on a gym machine
steps.progress.screenshotAlt: Fort's progress screen with a chart of the estimated one-rep max of the back squat
features.title: Everything you use at the gym. Nothing you don't.
features.measure.title: Every exercise, measured its way
features.measure.description: Weight and reps, reps with your body weight, time, or distance and time. Fort adapts to each exercise.
features.offline.title: Works offline
features.offline.description: Everything is saved on your phone, with no account and no internet. A basement gym is no longer a problem.
features.colors.title: Your color
features.colors.description: Pick one of six accent colors for the app.
features.bmi.title: Body weight and BMI
features.bmi.description: Log your weight, add your height and Fort works out your BMI. It can also remind you when to weigh in.
features.bmi.label: BMI
features.custom.title: Your own exercises
features.custom.description: Missing one of the 311? Create it and use it in your routines like any other.
features.activity.title: Your activity at a glance
features.activity.description: Every workout is saved and marked on your activity calendar. Look back at any day whenever you like.

privacy.title: Fort privacy policy
privacy.intro: Fort keeps everything you log on your device only. There are no accounts, servers, ads or analytics.
privacy.stored.title: What is stored
privacy.stored.intro: In the app's database, on your device:
privacy.stored.routines: Your routines and the exercises you add
privacy.stored.bodyWeight: Your body weight, if you log it
privacy.stored.profile: Your profile, if you fill it in: height, date of birth and gender
privacy.stored.preferences: Your preferences: appearance, units and language
privacy.stored.notifications: Your notification preferences, with the day and time of the weigh-in reminder
privacy.stored.storage: This data lives in the app's private storage, which the system keeps other apps from accessing.
privacy.notDone.title: What the app doesn't do
privacy.notDone.account: Ask you for an account or required personal details
privacy.permissions.title: Permissions
privacy.permissions.notificationsText: to show the notification of the workout in progress and the weigh-in reminder. They are optional and can be turned off in the app or in the system settings.
privacy.permissions.startupText: to schedule the weigh-in reminder again after the phone restarts, because Android clears its alarms when it turns off.
privacy.backups.title: Backups
privacy.backups.system: If you have system backups turned on (Google), your data may be included in them, like any other app's. Those backups depend on your account, not on the app.
privacy.backups.export: You can also export your data from Settings. It creates a file with everything you log, your profile included, and you decide where to save it or who to send it to. The app only keeps the last exported copy, in its private storage. When you import, the app reads only the file you choose.
privacy.deleting.title: Deleting your data
privacy.deleting.text: Uninstalling the app deletes everything it had stored on your device. Copies you exported and saved elsewhere are not deleted.
privacy.images.title: Exercise images
privacy.images.text: The exercise images are generated with artificial intelligence (OpenAI).
privacy.website.title: This website
privacy.website.text: This website doesn't use cookies or analytics, and it doesn't collect personal data.
privacy.changes.title: Changes
privacy.changes.text: If a future version changes how your data is handled (for example, to sync it between devices), it will be explained here before it happens.
